elements.name: midday small town in Ethiopian highlands
young man seen from behind in the centre
bundles tied on the roof rack
plain front with no sign and no plate
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs
tall thin eucalyptus trees with drooping leaves
sun high overhead with short shadows

wrong_setting: The vehicle is a three-wheeled auto-rickshaw, not a country bus, and the houses have terracotta tile roofs with leafy deciduous trees, which reads as a South Asian or Mediterranean street rather than the Ethiopian highlands.
anatomy: The legs and leather shoes standing in front of the rickshaw are fused with the driver's torso behind the windscreen, so one figure is split across the vehicle body.
notes: Regenerate: show the slim young man from behind in the centre with his backpack, dark jacket and plastic sandals, facing a boxy old bus with a blank front, with tin-roofed mud houses, eucalyptus trees and red dusty ground; remove the rickshaw, its occupants, the badge and the lettering.
